final: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT tr.tradekind AS trader_type, COUNT(*) AS type_count FROM transactionrecord AS tx JOIN trader AS tr ON tx.trdref = tr.tradereg GROUP BY tr.tradekind), totals AS (SELECT SUM(type_count) AS total_count, AVG(type_count) AS average_count FROM type_counts) SELECT trader_type, type_count, type_count * 1.0 / total_count AS share_of_total, type_count - average_count AS count_above_average FROM type_counts CROSS JOIN totals WHERE type_count > average_count
